title: Database Foundation
description: Establish the global Kysely database module with full schema types, a single initial migration creating all tables, and automatic migration runner.
acceptance_criteria: DatabaseModule is decorated with @Global() and exports DatabaseService
DatabaseService extends Kysely<Database> and connects using process.env.DATABASE_URL
types.ts defines interfaces for organizations, users, projects, and tasks tables and exports Database interface
Every table interface includes tenant_id: string except organizations which has no tenant_id
Generated<> is used ONLY on id, created_at, updated_at, is_active columns
users.role type is 'Admin' | 'ProjectManager' | 'Member'
projects.status type is 'Active' | 'Archived'
tasks.status type is 'ToDo' | 'InProgress' | 'Completed'
001_initial.ts creates organizations, users, projects, tasks tables with all columns, constraints, foreign keys, checks, unique constraints, and indexes exactly as defined in requirements
users table has UNIQUE (tenant_id, email)
projects table has UNIQUE (tenant_id, name)
tasks.project_id references projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
users.tenant_id and projects.tenant_id and tasks.tenant_id reference organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
migrate.ts runs all pending migrations using Kysely Migrator on application bootstrap
app.module.ts imports DatabaseModule

title: Authentication Module
description: Implement JWT authentication with register, login, refresh token, global guard, and role-based decorators.
acceptance_criteria: AuthController exposes POST /api/auth/register marked with @Public()
RegisterDto has email: @IsEmail(), password: @IsString() @MinLength(8), first_name: @IsString() @MinLength(1), last_name: @IsString() @MinLength(1)
POST /api/auth/register NEVER accepts role in body and role is hardcoded to 'Member'
POST /api/auth/register hashes password using bcrypt with 12 salt rounds
POST /api/auth/register returns 201 with { id, email, first_name, last_name, role, tenant_id }
POST /api/auth/login marked with @Public() returns { access_token, refresh_token, user: { id, email, role, tenant_id } }
Invalid login credentials throw UnauthorizedException
JWT payload contains sub, email, role, tenant_id
jwt.strategy validate() returns { id, email, role, tenant_id } assigned to req.user
JwtAuthGuard is registered globally using APP_GUARD in app.module.ts
RolesGuard is registered globally using APP_GUARD in app.module.ts
@Public() decorator bypasses global guard
@Roles('Admin') decorator enforces exact role match
AuthController has NO @UseGuards() decorator
All database queries filter by tenant_id where applicable
AuthModule is added to app.module.ts imports

title: Organizations Module
description: Implement organization creation endpoint that creates organization and first Admin user and returns JWT access token.
acceptance_criteria: OrganizationsController exposes POST /api/organizations marked with @Public()
CreateOrganizationDto has name: @IsString() @MinLength(1), email: @IsEmail(), password: @MinLength(8), first_name: @IsString(), last_name: @IsString()
POST /api/organizations creates new organization row
POST /api/organizations creates first user with role 'Admin' and tenant_id equal to organization id
Password hashed with bcrypt(12)
Returns 201 with { access_token, user: { id, email, role: 'Admin', tenant_id } }
Organization name must be unique else throw ConflictException
All inserts include tenant_id where applicable
OrganizationsController has NO @UseGuards() decorator
OrganizationsModule is added to app.module.ts imports

title: Users Module
description: Provide tenant-scoped user listing and role management for Admin users.
acceptance_criteria: UsersController exposes GET /api/users with pagination query params page and limit
GET /api/users requires @Roles('Admin')
GET /api/users returns { data: User[], meta: { total, page, limit, totalPages } }
Each user object contains id, email, first_name, last_name, role, is_active, created_at
GET /api/users queries must include .where('tenant_id', '=', req.user.tenant_id)
Pagination defaults: page=1, limit=20, max limit=100
UsersController exposes PATCH /api/users/:id/role requiring @Roles('Admin')
UpdateUserRoleDto has role: @IsIn(['Admin','ProjectManager','Member'])
PATCH /api/users/:id/role throws ForbiddenException if id equals req.user.id
PATCH /api/users/:id/role ensures target user belongs to same tenant else NotFoundException
UsersController has NO @UseGuards() decorator
UsersModule is added to app.module.ts imports

title: Projects Module
description: Enable tenant-scoped project creation, listing, updating, and deletion with role restrictions.
acceptance_criteria: ProjectsController exposes POST /api/projects requiring @Roles('Admin','ProjectManager')
CreateProjectDto has name: @IsString() @MinLength(1), description: @IsOptional() @IsString(), status: @IsIn(['Active','Archived'])
POST /api/projects enforces UNIQUE (tenant_id, name) else ConflictException
POST /api/projects inserts tenant_id from req.user.tenant_id and created_by from req.user.id
ProjectsController exposes GET /api/projects with pagination
GET /api/projects for Admin and ProjectManager returns all tenant projects filtered by tenant_id
GET /api/projects for Member returns only projects where tasks assigned_to = req.user.id
GET /api/projects returns { data: Project[], meta: { total, page, limit, totalPages } }
ProjectsController exposes PATCH /api/projects/:id requiring @Roles('Admin','ProjectManager')
PATCH prevents modifying Archived project except status field
ProjectsController exposes DELETE /api/projects/:id requiring @Roles('Admin')
DELETE relies on ON DELETE CASCADE for tasks
All queries include .where('tenant_id', '=', req.user.tenant_id)
ProjectsController has NO @UseGuards() decorator
ProjectsModule is added to app.module.ts imports

title: Tasks Module
description: Provide full task management with tenant isolation and role-based access control.
acceptance_criteria: TasksController exposes POST /api/tasks requiring @Roles('Admin','ProjectManager')

CreateTaskDto has project_id: @IsUUID(), title: @IsString() @MinLength(1), description: @IsOptional() @IsString(), status: @IsIn(['ToDo','InProgress','Completed']), assigned_to: @IsOptional() @IsUUID()
POST /api/tasks verifies project exists with same tenant_id else NotFoundException
POST /api/tasks verifies assigned_to user belongs to same tenant if provided
TasksController exposes GET /api/tasks with pagination
GET /api/tasks for Admin and ProjectManager returns all tenant tasks
GET /api/tasks for Member returns only tasks where assigned_to = req.user.id
GET /api/tasks returns { data: Task[], meta: { total, page, limit, totalPages } }
TasksController exposes PATCH /api/tasks/:id
PATCH allowed for Admin and ProjectManager always
PATCH allowed for Member only if task.assigned_to === req.user.id else ForbiddenException
TasksController exposes DELETE /api/tasks/:id requiring @Roles('Admin','ProjectManager')
All queries include .where('tenant_id', '=', req.user.tenant_id)
TasksController has NO @UseGuards() decorator
TasksModule is added to app.module.ts imports

title: Dashboard and Notifications Module
description: Provide aggregated dashboard metrics and basic notification listing per tenant.
acceptance_criteria: DashboardController exposes GET /api/dashboard requiring authenticated user
GET /api/dashboard returns { total_projects, total_tasks, tasks_by_status: { ToDo, InProgress, Completed } } scoped to tenant_id
All dashboard queries include .where('tenant_id', '=', req.user.tenant_id)
NotificationsController exposes GET /api/notifications with pagination
GET /api/notifications returns { data: Notification[], meta: { total, page, limit, totalPages } }
Notifications are scoped by tenant_id and user_id = req.user.id
DashboardController and NotificationsController have NO @UseGuards() decorator
DashboardModule and NotificationsModule are added to app.module.ts imports

title: Audit Logs Module
description: Implement tenant-scoped audit logging of critical actions with Admin-only access.
acceptance_criteria: Add audit_logs table definition to types.ts with id, tenant_id, user_id, action, entity, entity_id, created_at
Generated<> used only on id and created_at in audit_logs table type
001_initial.ts updated to create audit_logs table with FK to organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
AuditController exposes GET /api/audit-logs requiring @Roles('Admin')
GET /api/audit-logs supports pagination and returns { data: AuditLog[], meta: { total, page, limit, totalPages } }
All queries include .where('tenant_id', '=', req.user.tenant_id)
AuditController has NO @UseGuards() decorator
AuditModule is added to app.module.ts imports
